WITH u AS (
  SELECT id, created_at FROM public.users WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
orders AS (
  SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS ord_count
  FROM u
  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
    AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY u.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ord_count >= 2)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS share
FROM orders

SELECT u.traffic_source,
       ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue_per_user
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at))/3600) AS median_hours FROM public.order_items WHERE status = 'Complete' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS users_created,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned') AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue_2024
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM orders
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.second_order - p.first_order))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivot p
JOIN public.users u ON u.id = p.user_id
WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
  AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT id, created_at, DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month
  FROM public.users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
conv AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.month,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi
      WHERE oi.user_id = c.id AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
        AND oi.created_at >= c.created_at AND oi.created_at < c.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
    ) AS converted
  FROM cohort c
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(month,'YYYY-MM') AS month, 
  COUNT(*) AS users, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS converted_users,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)::numeric,4) AS share
FROM conv
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH facebook_users AS (
  SELECT id FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN facebook_users fu ON fu.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
  FROM orders
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_date END) AS second_order,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN order_date END) AS third_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN order_date END) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (third_order - second_order))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivot

WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_spend
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend) AS p90
FROM per_user

WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Organic'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT r1.user_id,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r2.order_date - r1.order_date))/86400.0 AS days_diff
  FROM ranked r1
  JOIN ranked r2 ON r1.user_id = r2.user_id AND r1.rn = 1 AND r2.rn = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) AS median_days
FROM pairs

WITH order_agg AS (
  SELECT order_id, user_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time, SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS order_value,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Cancelled') AS n_noncancel
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
valid_orders AS (
  SELECT * FROM order_agg WHERE n_noncancel > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM valid_orders
)
SELECT
  (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1) -
  (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM ranked WHERE rn > 1) AS diff

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_date
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
  FROM orders
),
firsttwo AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN order_date END) AS d1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_date END) AS d2
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d2-d1))/86400.0) AS p95_days
FROM firsttwo

WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Search'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS first_order,
         MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivoted
